integrity: Full proof and a self-contained exact-arithmetic finite checker are supplied; only same-model scientific review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only equivalences obtained by partitioning singular matrix ranks, while separating the identity from other units; arbitrary monoid dimensionalities and quotient-isomorphism types are not classified. Finite checks do not establish the all-field theorem. Historical priority against unindexed rank-partition literature remains a residual risk.
title: Rank-block dimensionalities of matrix monoids and numerical semigroups
